alt: 書法家展示寫著一個「文」字的書頁，眾人讚賞圍觀，一位欣賞者捧出滿盒金幣。
scene_prompt: An original calligrapher displays an open book bearing one excellent original handwritten Chinese character 文 on one page, the other page blank. Admiring adults gather close, and a collector offers a chest of gold coins for this highly valued calligraphic character. Preserve original watercolor pencil scene and composition.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. Allow exactly one original handwritten Chinese glyph 文 on one open page only. No other text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
